name: Gait3D
description: This is the code for the paper "Gait Recognition in the Wild with Dense 3D Representations and A Benchmark. (CVPR 2022)", "Gait Recognition in the Wild with Multi-hop Temporal Switch", "Parsing is All You Need for Accurate Gait Recognition in the Wild", and "It Takes Two: Accurate Gait Recognition in the Wild via Cross-granularity Alignment".
